name: karp-inspector
description: 52-tool unified development intelligence server. Filesystem CRUD, knowledge graph, semantic code search, index observability, dependency analysis, security audit, safe terminal execution — all in one. Your code never leaves your machine.

data_path.title: Data Folder
data_path.description: Choose where to store your knowledge graph and code index. Pick any folder — your data stays on your machine and survives extension updates.

project_dirs.title: Project Folders
project_dirs.description: Choose one or more top-level folders Claude can read, write, and search within (subfolders included). This is the file boundary for all filesystem tools — Claude can't touch anything outside these. Click again to add more.

allowed_commands.title: Allowed Terminal Commands
allowed_commands.description: Semicolon-separated command prefixes run_check may execute. Defaults to syntax checking only. IMPORTANT: adding test or build runners (npm test, npm run build, pytest) lets a project execute its own code on your machine — npm scripts come from that project's package.json, and pytest runs its conftest.py. Only add those for repositories you trust. Example: node --check;npm test;npm run lint;npm run build;pytest
